title: Speed limit warnings and high-speed stability
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on speed limit warnings that some drivers find helpful or useful while others dislike the default-on beeping and repeated need to switch it off, with a separate positive thread about high-speed stability.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the usefulness of speed warning alerts and speed limit displays, and some also mention strong high-speed stability.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain that the speed limit bong is annoying, sometimes inaccurate, and switched on by default or hard to disable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention speed limit alerts, beeping, or turning the warning off, but the short fragments often do not make the sentiment fully clear.

signal_notes.interpretation: The flagged GB association aligns with the available examples, where the negative comments shown about default-on or irritating speed limit beeping all come from GB fragments, but this is an exploratory pattern only.

limitations: A large share of reviews in this topic are undetermined, so the sentiment picture is incomplete.
The topic mixes two related but distinct subjects: speed limit warnings/alerts and high-speed stability.
Several example fragments are very short, which limits confidence about the exact sentiment or detailed issue in those cases.
Examples are sampled rather than representative, so they show themes present in the topic without estimating how common each theme is overall.
